title: Roomies is out today on iOS and Android. It’s a pixel pet with an AI brain that runs on your phone!
author: Agitated_Teach_7484
selftext:
My friend and I make small apps out of Detroit, and today we released Roomies!

It’s a virtual pet in the Tamagotchi and lofi style. The difference is that an AI writes what he says while you play, so he reacts to how his day goes and forms his own opinions over time. The AI runs locally on your phone. You open the app and start.

If you don’t like AI you can toggle it off and use our precanned pet speech.

24 unique pets to choose from, each with color options    
9 mini games    
A lo-fi music player    
One room that changes light from morning to night    
Food, rest, fun, water, and love stats to keep up

This one is just for fun, no data collected or money made off this in any way. 

And shoutout to pixel lab ai for giving me the power to turn my notebook sketches into dancing pixel pets, and superpowers via Claude to help clean up my terrible code. 

  
download links at [airoomies.com](http://airoomies.com) 

  
Open to any feedback!
